'''Doellinism''' was a religion that worshiped [[Doellin]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kinyen/Legends|Kinyen]]. Its tenets forbade violence, and forms of addiction such as [[Alcohol/Legends|alcohol]], [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]], and [[Spice/Legends|spice]]. After the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Massacre at Malthee|bombarded]] the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Malthee]] on Kinyen, a Doellinist temple was built in the ruins of the city.<ref name="Strongholds of Resistance" />

Doellinist priests secretly met with agents of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="Strongholds of Resistance" />
